about.name: Vestige (理学)
about.description:
A workspace for editing and proofreading transcripts, and exploring the archaeology of your own life.
We preserve memories to keep a doorway to another possibility, at least in our hearts.
With them, we can live our lives over, thousands upon thousands of times.
about.quote:
I have made many choices. Some quietly, without noticing; others after careful thought. In happiness and in sorrow. Some of my own accord, others under pressure. Some fell naturally into place; others came about by chance.
I know that, long from now, somewhere, one night, I will remember the roads to the rose garden that I never took.
I chose one road, and that has made all the difference.
